Card Q&A.a: Yes, it does. This Digimon counts toward this card's effect.
Card Q&A.q: Does this card's effect count this Digimon itself?

Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. The effect only targets 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
Card Q&A.q: I have 2 Digimon in play. Can I use this card's effect to give -1000 DP each to 2 of my opponent's Digimon?

Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. The [On Play] effect has already finished activating.
Card Q&A.q: After playing this Digimon, I play another Digimon during the same turn. Since I now have more Digimon in play, can I give my opponent's Digimon an additional -1000 DP?

Effect: [On Play] For each Digimon you have in play, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -1000 DP for the turn.
